latest_messages.headline: Pre-market: all 5 holdings healthy, no trades, watching CFR
latest_messages.body: Ran the 4-agent research scan pre-open. No bad news on any holding and none reports earnings this week; JPM added a $20B Qatar deal, MDT got an FDA clearance. CFR is the one watch — fundamentals sound (MS upgrade, deposits growing), but bank-sector rotation left it ~2.8% above its stop. Sleeve full 5/5; nothing on the bench beats our weakest hold, so no swap. Re-check at the open.

latest_messages.body: Quiet, soft day — no trades, held all six positions with every stop verified. We slipped $722 (−0.74%) on a flat-SPY day, dragged by our banks/defensives (CFR −4.3%, RMD −2.9%, MDT −2.1%); JPM and the SPY sleeve held up. Behind for the week (−1.96% alpha) after only partly catching SPY's Monday pop. Watching CFR's tight ~2.8% cushion to its stop; full news scan before tomorrow's open.
